note: Replaces the actual noun forms with several false glosses and loses the explicit inflection claim.

bar_text: Ähnli wia Bua flektian de Wärter Rob und Schwob: olle Forman außa Nominativ Singular hom an Stej vo -b an Stammauslaut -m: Rom (Robm), Schwom (Schwobm); de Pluralform Roma (Robma), Schwoma (Schwobma) san sejtn.
english: Similar to the word Bua, the words Rob and Schwob decline: all forms except nominative singular have a change from -b to the stem consonant -m: Rom (Robm), Schwom (Schwobm); the plural forms Roma (Robma), Schwoma (Schwobma) are rare.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: As grammatische Gschlecht vo an Substantiv wead am Artikel markiat.
english: The grammatical gender of a noun is marked by the article.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Oft is as Gschlecht wia im Deitschn.
english: Often it is the gender as in German.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Bei de Personalpronomina untascheidd s Boarische teiweis, so wia vui romanische und slawische Sprochn, zwischn betontn und unbetontn Foama im Dativ (nur 1.,
english: Regarding the personal pronouns, Bavarian partially distinguishes, like many Romance and Slavic languages, between stressed and unstressed forms in the dative (only 1.,
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: 2. Singular) und Akkusativ (nur
english: 2. Singular) and accusative (only
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: * De Foama gejten ois „weniga“ boarisch, san dafia oba typisch ostfränggisch.
english: The drivers are considered "less" Bavarian, but are in return typically East Franconian.
note: Foama means forms, not drivers.

bar_text: Bei da Kombination vo mearan unbetontn Personalpronomina, de wo af -'s verkiazt san, wead da Bindevokal -a- einegschom; bei da Reihenfoige vo da Ordnung gibts, im Gengasotz zum Deitschn, vaschiedane Variantn.
english: In the case of a combination of several unstressed personal pronouns that are shortened with -'s, the connecting vowel -a- is inserted; regarding the sequence of the order, in contrast to German, there are different variants.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Dabei ko in (1.a) und (1.b) ebmso weng wia im Deitschn untaschiedn wean, obsa si bei erra um de 3. Person Singular feminin oda um de 3. Person Plural handlt.
english: In this regard, (1.a) and (1.b) can be distinguished about as much as in German, whether it concerns the 3rd person singular feminine or the 3rd person plural.
note: Loses the explicit cannot/as-little distinction and the actual ambiguous form erra.

bar_text: Aa de Possessivpronomina deina und seina flektiaen so.
english: Also the possessive pronouns yours and his inflect like that.
note: Replaces the cited deina/seina forms with English yours/his, losing the actual inflecting forms.

bar_text: S Possessivpronomen (Fem. Sg.) iara is vom Standarddeitschn iwanumma woan; urspringli vawendt s Boarische fia weibliche Bsitza ebmfois s Pronomen seina.
english: The possessive pronoun (fem. sg.) iara was taken from Standard German; originally, Bavarian also used the pronoun seina for female owners.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Oft wead a s substantiviate Adjektiv da mei(nige) (da dei(nige), da sei(nige), im Plural: de meinign, de deinign …) vawendt: „Wem ghead der?“ – „Des is da mei!“
english: Often a substantivized adjective is used as my (yours, his, in the plural: mine, yours, his ...) : "Whom does it belong to?" – "That is mine!"
note: Translates away the actual singular/plural nominalized adjective forms that are central examples.

bar_text: So wia de Possessivpronomina flektian de Indefinitpronomina koana sowia oana; ma ko vors Letztare s Wort iagad- stejn.
english: Just as the possessive pronouns inflect the indefinite pronouns, none [do it] like one; one can place the word "iagad-" before the last syllable.
note: Garbles the shared inflection statement and changes prefix placement before oana to before the last syllable.

bar_text: Do wead oiso ned zwischn de Geschlechta, sundan zwischn Persona und Socha untaschiedn.
english: So we do not distinguish between the genders, but rather between person and thing.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Vui vo de boarischn Adjektive hom a Kurzfoam und a Langfoam.
english: Many of the Bavarian adjectives have a short form and a long form.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De Kurzfoam wead in prädikativa Stellung vawendt.
english: The short form is used in a predicative position.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: D. h. dann, wen s Adjektiv mitm Huifsverb sein a Prädikat buidt (de Schuah san schwoaz).
english: I.e. then, when the adjective with the auxiliary verb forms a predicate (the shoes are black).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De Langfoam kimmt dann vor, wann s Adjektiv ois Attribut vo am Substantiv vawendt wead (de schwoazn Schuah).
english: The long form then comes when the adjective is used as an attribute of a noun (the black shoes).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Moastns liegt da Untaschied zwischn Kurz- und Langfoam im Endkonsonanten.
english: In the morning, the difference between short and long forms lies in the final consonant.
note: Moastns means mostly, not in the morning; invents a time condition.

bar_text: Oft san des -n, -ch, -g.
english: Often these are -n, -ch, -g.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Wia im Deitschn wean Adjektive in attributiva Stejung flektiat, d. h. se griagn vaschiedne Endunga.
english: As in German, adjectives in attributive position are inflected, i.e., they receive different endings.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Dabei muass untaschiedn wean, obs mid an Substantiv mid bstimmtn Artikl gengan (und dahea sejm in bstimmta Foam flektian), oda obs mid an unbstimmtn Artikl zamm san (und nacha dementsprechend nach an unbstimmtn Musta dekliniat wean).
english: In this case, a distinction must be made whether it is with a noun with a definite article (and therefore must be inflected in a certain form), or whether it is together with an indefinite article (and is then subsequently declined according to an indefinite pattern).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Wean Adjektive substantiviat vawendt, oiso nua mit Artikl, nacha richtn sa si ebnfois noch dem.
english: Adjectives are used as nouns, so only with an article, and then they also inflect accordingly.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Ois Beispui deant as Adjektiv schee, des wo am Stamm bei da Flexion um -n daweitad wead (aussa beim Neutrum Singular).
english: As an example, the adjective "schee" (beautiful) serves, which is extended by -n at the stem during inflection (except in the neuter singular).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Im Boarischen deant as Suffix -a zur Buidung vom Komparativ, vo da easchtn Steigarungsform.
english: In Bavarian, the suffix -a serves for the formation of the comparative, from the first degree of comparison.
note: Changes the first-degree apposition to a from relation.

bar_text: Grundlog vom Komparativ is de obm bschriebane Langform; bei mangn Adjektivn kimts zu Umlautn, bei andan zua Vaendarung in da Vokalleng oda im konsonantischn Auslaut.
english: The basis of the comparative is the long form described above; with many adjectives it leads to umlauts, with others to a change in the vowel or in the consonantal coda.
note: Generic change in the vowel loses the source's specific length change.

bar_text: Fian Superlativ wead je nach Landschaft, a eigane Form af -st buidd oda owa aa ned.
english: For the superlative, depending on the landscape, there is a special form ending in -st, or not.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: In letztan Foi wead da Komparativ ois Superlativasotz heagnumma.
english: In the last case, the comparative is taken as a superlative sentence.
note: Superlativasotz means superlative substitute/replacement, not a superlative sentence.

bar_text: So ko da Sotz „Max Müller ist der größte der zwölf Knaben“ im Boarischen foigende Varianten produzian: „Vo de zwejf Buam is da Müller Max am gressan (Komparativ)/am gresstn (Superlativ)/sejtn da gresste/da gressane.“
english: Thus the sentence "Max Müller is the greatest of the twelve boys" can produce the following variants in Bavarian: "Of the twelve boys, Müller Max is the greatest (comparative)/the greatest (superlative)/seldom the greatest/the greatest."
note: Replaces gressan/gresstn/gresste/gressane with identical English greatest forms, erasing the contrast being exemplified.

bar_text: Boarische Zoiweata endn moastns af -e, des wo owa in attributiva Stejung oft wegfoid.
english: Bavarian number words mostly end in -e, which often falls away in the attributive position.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De Numeralia flektian ned, Ausnohm is as Zoiwoat oans fia de Zoi 1.
english: The numerals do not inflect, with the exception of the ordinal number one for the number 1.
note: oans for the number 1 is cardinal, not ordinal.

bar_text: Im Boarischn is da Iwagang vo da Wortbeigung zum Sotzbau (Sidntax) oft fliaßend, desweng kena vui Bereiche in da boarischen Grammatik vo da Morphosyntax am bestn eafosst wean.
english: In Bavarian, the transition from word inflection to sentence structure (syntax) is often fluid, which is why many areas in Bavarian grammar can best be understood as morphosyntax.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Prepositiona kena im Boarischn wia im Deitschn mit am bestimmtn Artikl zu am Woat vaschmejzn (vgl. dt. bei dem = beim, an dem = am, unter den = untern usw.).
english: Prepositions in Bavarian, like in German, can merge with a certain article into a word (cf. German bei dem = beim, an dem = am, unter den = untern etc.).
note: Certain article is imprecise for the grammatical category definite article.

bar_text: Im Boarisch wead des vui efta ogwendt.
english: In Bavarian, this is often turned around much more frequently.
note: ogwendt means used/applied, not turned around.

bar_text: Wei Prepositiona de Betonung af s nochfoigande Sotzelement lenka, kena eahna nua betonte, obwa nia unbetonte Peasonalpronomina foign.
english: Since prepositions direct the emphasis onto the following sentence element, they can only be stressed if no unstressed personal pronouns follow.
note: Changes which personal pronouns can follow into a condition on stressing the prepositions themselves.

bar_text: Im Boarischn wean fia Ortschaftn und Städt eascht seitm Eifluss ausm Hochdeitschn aa "nach" und "in" braucht.
english: In Bavarian, "nach" and "in" are only used for villages and towns since the influence of High German.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Traditionej sogt ma im Boarischn owa a oda af/auf (= nach) und z (= in).
english: Traditionally, one says in Bavarian however "oda af/auf" (= nach) and "z" (= in).
note: Loses the a option and misincludes oda/or in the cited preposition.

bar_text: Ma foaht oisdann af Augschburg oda bleibt z Minga.
english: One drives then towards Augsburg or stays in Munich.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Bei Feiatog findt se je noch Region entweda ebmfois as z: z Ostan, z Weihnachtn; oda af: af Ostan, af Weihnachtn; oda untam Eifluss vo da Standardsproch an.
english: On holidays, depending on the region, it is either influenced by: in Easter, at Christmas; or by: on Easter, on Christmas; or under the influence of the standard language.
note: Loses the cited prepositions and an, and changes the first holiday example to in Easter.

bar_text: Im Boarischn sogt ma soichane Weata owa nia nid ohne Prepositiona zua Zeitogob.
english: In Bavarian, one never says such words regarding a time period without prepositions.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: A regionale Besonderheit is de temporale Konjunktion aft, de wo in großn Toaln vom boarischn Sprochgebiet vawendt wiad.
english: A regional peculiarity is the temporal conjunction "aft", which is used in large parts of the Bavarian language area.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Etymologisch gseng entspricht des am englischn after und hoasst „nacha, danoch“.
english: Etymologically speaking, this corresponds to the English "after" and means "after, afterwards".
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: In de siidboarischn Dialekte tretn präpositionslose Orts- und Richtungsogobm (Adverbialien) af.
english: In the South Bavarian dialects, prepositionless locational and directional specifications (adverbials) occur.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Ma gähd oisdann ned in de Kira oda afn Moakt, sundan ma gähd Kira/Moakt, ohne a Präposition z vawendn.
english: One doesn't go into the church or to the market then, but one goes church/market, without using a preposition.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De Lokalbedeitung wiad duachs Ausbleibm vom Artikl markiat, dea wo sont bei jedm Substantiv obligatorisch is.
english: The local meaning is marked through the absence of the article, which is mandatory with every noun.
note: Drops otherwise, leaving absence and universal mandatory use without the explicit exception marker.

bar_text: Weidane Beispui: i wohn Augschburg, i wor Schui, ea gähd easchte Klass Schui (vgl. aa lat. Romae in Rom, Romam nach Rom; Hindi Dillî calnâ af Delhi foahn, stott Dillî ko calnâ).
english: Other examples: I live in Augsburg, I was at school, he goes to first grade school (cf. also lat. Romae in Rome, Romam to Rome; Hindi Dillî calnâ from Delhi, instead of Dillî ko calnâ).
note: Reverses to Delhi to from Delhi and loses the prepositionless structure of the Bavarian examples.

bar_text: S Boarische hod a komplexes System vo Richtungsadverbialien, de wo oan Bezug zua Perspektivn vom Sprecha nehma.
english: Bavarian has a complex system of directional adverbials, which take a reference to the perspectives of the speaker.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Wia im Deitschn muass, je noch dem, ob de Bewegung vom Sprecha weg oda zum Sprecha hi voizong wiad, a ensprechends Affix ogfiagt wean (im Weanarischn san de zwoa Affixe zammagfoin, s wead do oisdann koa Untaschied mea gmocht).
english: As in German, depending on whether the movement of the speaker is counted away from or towards the speaker, a corresponding affix must be attached (in Viennese, the two affixes have merged, so no distinction is made there anymore).
note: Makes the motion the speaker's own movement rather than any movement relative to the speaker.

bar_text: Im Deitschn wean de Affixe ois Präfixe (hin- bzw. her-) vawendt, oisa am Adverb vorogstejt.
english: In German, the affixes are used as prefixes (hin- or her-), thus placed before the adverb.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Im Boarischn wean de Affixe ois Suffixe eigsetzt, d. h. am Adverb hinten ogfiagt; s Suffix -hin wead zu -i, regional -e obgschwächt, s Suffix -her zu -a.
english: In Bavarian, the affixes are used as suffixes, i.e., attached to the end of the adverb; the suffix -hin becomes -i, regionally weakened to -e, the suffix -her to -a.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De Iwasicht zoagt de Richtungsadverbien, wias worscheinli im gonzn boarischn Raum iblich gwen san.
english: The overview shows the directional adverbs as they were probably common throughout the entire Bavarian region.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Im westlichn Obabayern gengan de Formen scho längere Zeit ollawei mehra zruck und ma verwendt Formen de näha on da Hochsproch und näha am Schwäbischn san.
english: In western Upper Bavaria, the forms have been receding more and more for a long time, and forms are being used that are closer to the standard language and closer to Swabian.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Es is dort oiso im easchtn Schritt "auffi, auffa", "obi, oba", "eini, eina", "ummi, umma" durch "nauf, rauf", "no, ro", "nei, rei", "num, rum" ersetzt worn.
english: So, in the first step, it was replaced there by "up, up", "down, down", "in, in", "around, around" through "nauf, rauf", "no, ro", "nei, rei", "num, rum".
note: Translates away the old auffi/auffa etc. forms whose replacement is being documented.

bar_text: Wei se "no, ro" und "num", "rum" aa net so hochsprochli ohearn, wead des haintztog aa oft mit "nunta, runta" und "niba/nüba, riba/riwa/rüba" ersetzt.
english: Because "no, ro" and "num", "rum" also do not sound so high-register, nowadays this is also often replaced with "nunta, runta" and "niba/nüba, riba/riwa/rüba".
note: High-register does not precisely preserve hochsprochli/standard-language-like.

bar_text: Es gibt an broatn Stroafa wo ma "nauf, rauf"... und "auffi/auffar" … nebmanand verwendt.
english: There is a broad sentence where one uses "nauf, rauf"... and "auffi/auffar" … next to each other.
note: A geographic strip becomes a sentence, changing where the forms coexist.

bar_text: Im Sidwestn vo Oberbayern hom se de Richtungsadverbien mit da Nochsuibm "i" und "a/ar/r" bessar hoitn kenna wia im Nordwestn vo Obabayern.
english: In the southwest of Upper Bavaria, they were able to hold the directional adverbs with the suffix "i" and "a/ar/r" better than in the northwest of Upper Bavaria.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Im Boarischn hods an Prozess gebm, dea wo in da Sprochwissnschoft Klitisiarung hoasst.
english: In Bavarian, there has been a process that is called cliticization in linguistics.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Wos Boarische betrifft, so is damit s Drohenga vo Personalpronomina ans konjugiate Verb gmoant.
english: As far as Bavarian is concerned, the dropping of personal pronouns from a conjugated verb is meant by it.
note: Changes attachment to its opposite, dropping pronouns from the verb.

bar_text: Aus mia wiad -ma, aus dia wiad -da, se wiad zu -s usw. Vo da Obschwechung is nacha aa nua mea a kloana Schritt zua Kontraktion vom Verb mitm Personalpronom.
english: From me becomes -ma, from you becomes -da, she becomes zu -s etc. After the weakening, it is then also just a small step towards the contraction of the verb with the personal pronoun.
note: Translates away the cited input forms and leaves zu untranslated, obscuring the actual reductions.

bar_text: De Klitisiarung is a da Grund, weshoib s Pronoma vo da 1. Person Plural im Boarischn af m- olautet.
english: The declension is the reason why the pronoun of the 1st person plural in Bavarian ends in m.
note: Cliticization becomes declension and initial m- becomes final m.

bar_text: De middlhochdeitsche Verb-Endung -n und da Olaut vom Persoanalpronom wir san zum m vaschmoizn (ebenso im Schwäbischn).
english: The Middle High German verb ending -n and the umlaut of the personal pronoun wir are used to close m (likewise in Swabian).
note: Initial sound becomes umlaut and merger becomes used to close m.

bar_text: m is dann vom Sprecha nimma länga ois Verb-Endung ogseng worn, sondan ois Olaut vom Personalpronom.
english: it was then no longer seen as a verb ending from the speaker, but as a full vowel of the personal pronoun.
note: Olaut is the initial sound, not a full vowel.

bar_text: Des Phänomen tritt oba ned nua in da 1. Person Plural im Nominativ af, a andane Persona wean klitisiat.
english: This phenomenon does not only occur in the 1st person plural in the nominative, other persons are also included.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Omeakung: De klitisiatn Personalpronoma san durch Bindestriche trennt.
english: Note: The small personal pronouns are separated by hyphens.
note: Small substitutes a vague size description for cliticized.

bar_text: Im easchtn Beispui weads direkte Objekt (Akkusativobjekt) klitisiat, wearend im zwoatn Subjekt und Akkusativobjekt ons Verb ogfiagt wean.
english: In the first example, the direct object (accusative object) will be analyzed, whereas in the second, subject and accusative object will be attached to our verb.
note: The first object's cliticization becomes analysis and the verb acquires an unsupported our.

bar_text: Im drittn Beispui gengan sogoa Subjekt, Akkusativ- und Dativobjekt a Vabindung mitm Verb ein.
english: In the third example, even subject, accusative and dative objects form a connection with the verb.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Oba ned nua de Verbn kenna ois Element gnutzt wean, an de wo de obgschächtn Personalpronomina ogfiagt wean.
english: But not only the verbs can be used as an element, to which the sent personal pronouns are attached.
note: Weakened personal pronouns become sent personal pronouns.

bar_text: Des is aa bei Nebmsotzeinleitan mäglich.
english: This is also possible with nebulizer inhalation.
note: Nebmsotzeinleitan means subordinate-clause introducers, not nebulizer inhalation.

bar_text: Wen a Personalpronoma klitisiat worn is, dann deaf de Voifoam davo nimma im gleichn Sotz vorkema: Se schloft oda Schloft-s?
english: Once a personal pronoun has been cliticized, then the full form of it may no longer appear in the same sentence: Does she sleep (Se schloft) or does she sleep (Schloft-s)?
note: Adds a question gloss for declarative Se schloft, though the original Bavarian forms remain.

bar_text: owa nia ned Se schloft-s, des warad ungrammatisch.
english: but never ever she sleeps, that would be ungrammatical.
note: Drops the clitic -s, incorrectly presenting ordinary she sleeps as the ungrammatical example.

bar_text: A Sondafoi und a Ausnohm za dem buidd de Nominativ-Form vo da 2. Person Singular und in an grossn Tei vom Boarischn aa de 2. Person Plural, sowia ia a poa Regiona aa de 1. Person Plural.
english: A special case and an exception to this picture, the nominative form of the 2nd person singular and in a large part of Bavarian also the 2nd person plural, as well as in a few regions also the 1st person plural.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Do liegt nacha ned nua a Klitisiarung vor, sondan de ehemolign Klitika hom scho an Status vo ana Flexionsendung.
english: Then it is not just a cliticization that occurs, but the former clitics already have the status of a flexion ending.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Das du vo da 2. Person Singular is scho im Oidhochdeitschn duach inverse Sotzstellung an de urspringliche Endung -s ogfiagt worn, de wo de heite aa standardsprochliche Endung -st eagem hod.
english: The fact that "du" is the 2nd person singular was already added to the original ending -s through inverse word order in Old High German, which has been replaced by the today's standard language ending -st.
note: Treats the fact that du is second singular as the attached element and changes formation of -st to replacement.

bar_text: Regional kena aa andane Obweichunga fiakema.
english: Regionally, there are also other deviations to be made.
note: Can occur becomes deviations to be made, changing possibility into prescription.

bar_text: Manche Verbn vom Boarischn erfordan a andane Rektion wia im Standarddeitschn, z. B. diaschtn („duastig sei“), drama („träumen“) und rein („bereuen“).
english: Some verbs of Bavarian require a different government than in Standard German, e.g., diaschtn (“to be dusty”), drama (“to dream”) and rein (“to regret”).
note: Changes thirsty to dusty in the verb's gloss.

bar_text: Se wean mitm logischn Subjektiv im Dativ oda Akkusativ gnuzd (sog. Quirky Case).
english: They will be used with the logical subject in the dative or accusative (so-called Quirky Case).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: A formals Subjekt ist efta ned voahandn.
english: A formal subject is probably not present beforehand.
note: Often becomes probably and vorhanden becomes present beforehand, inventing a temporal qualification.

bar_text: Im Boarischn wean, andas wiar im Standarddeitschn, Adjektive in attributiva Stejung markiat; dazu deant s invariable Suffix -a bzw. -e; s handelt se dobei um erstoarte Nom.
english: In Bavarian, unlike in Standard German, adjectives in the attributive position are marked; for this purpose, the invariable suffix -a or -e is used; these are inflected nouns.
note: Fossilized nominative forms become inflected nouns.

bar_text: -Forman (maskulin bzw. feminin).
english: -Forman (masculine or feminine).
note: Leaves Forman untranslated instead of forms.

bar_text: Soichane Attribute kenna af Subjekt wia aa Objekt bezogn sei.
english: Such attributes can be related to a subject as well as an object.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Des schmeggt koida bessa.
english: Nobody smells better than this.
note: Nobody smells better than this does not convey that the item tastes better cold.

bar_text: – Das schmeckt kalt besser.
english: – That tastes better cold.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Fost hedns eam lebanda eigrom.
english: They have already entered him alive.
note: Almost buried alive becomes already entered alive, changing both the action and whether it happened.

bar_text: – Fast hätten sie ihn lebendig eingegraben.
english: – They almost would have buried him alive.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Im Boarischn kimmt da doppetn Vanaanung a grosse Bedeitung zua.
english: In Bavarian, the double negation takes on a great importance.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Beispui: In da Stod huift koana neamd neda.
english: Example: In the city, no one helps anyone else.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Im Boarischn ko a Sotz amoi oda meamois vaneint wean, da Sinn bleibt in da Regl da gleiche.
english: In Bavarian, a sentence can sometimes be negated once or mostly, but the meaning remains the same in principle.
note: Once or multiple times becomes once or mostly, confusing number of negations with frequency.

bar_text: * neamdm und neamdn san vo da Aussproch hea ned zan Untascheidn.
english: * names and surnames cannot be distinguished by pronunciation.
note: Replaces the two pronoun forms with names and surnames.

bar_text: S formale Subjekt es wiad efta elidiat, z. B. er is da gresste Depp, wo gibt.
english: The formal subject is often eliminated, e.g., he is the biggest idiot there is.
note: Omits the identified es form and its explicit omission in the original example.

bar_text: A kloana Ibablick iba de wichtigstn Wortfejda und Meglichkeitn vo da Wortbuidung:
english: A small overview of the most important word fields and possibilities of word formation:
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Um dena regionaln Untaschiedn grecht zum wean, wean mange Wäate gsondat kennzeichnet: A Österreichischa Wortschotz B Oidbayrischa Wortschotz H Burgnländischa Wortschotz (Heanzisch) K Karntna Wortschotz S Steirischa Wortschotz T Tirola Wortschotz W Weana Wortschotz
english: To do justice to the regional differences, many words will be specially marked: A Austrian vocabulary B Old Bavarian vocabulary H Burgenland vocabulary (Heanzisch) K Carinthian vocabulary S Styrian vocabulary T Tyrolean vocabulary W Viennese vocabulary
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Fleischa (Metzger), Tischla (Schreiner), Spangla (Klempner), Bäck (Bäcker), Zeidla (Imker), Hafna (Töpfa), Sandla (W; Obdachlosa), Striezi (W; Zuahejta)
english: Butcher, carpenter, plumber, baker, beekeeper, potter, homeless person (W), outsider (W)
note: Omits the actual Bavarian words and changes the final pimp gloss to outsider.

bar_text: S Boarische hod oft a Vuizoi vo ausdrucksstoarkn Begriff fia a Soch.
english: Bavarian often has a multitude of expressive terms for a thing.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Fia Mund gibts zum Beispui Mai (ugs.), Goschn (frech) oda Goschal (liabevoi), Babbn (frech), Lätschn (obweatend) oda Fotzn (beleidigend).
english: For mouth, there are for example Mai (colloquial), Goschn (cheeky) or Goschal (full of love), Babbn (cheeky), Lätschn (disrespectful) or Fotzn (insulting).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: A fias Gwand gibts an Hafa typisch boarische Ausdrick: Gwand sejm,Joppn („Jackn“), Pfoidl oda Pfoadl (fia Hemad), Diandl z. B.
english: For clothing, there is a typical Bavarian expression: Gwand (clothing), Joppn ("jacket"), Pfoidl or Pfoadl (for shirts), Diandl, for example.
note: Changes a wealth of expressions to a singular expression, despite retaining the list.

bar_text: Fia d Viecha gibt aa an bsondan boarischn Woatschotz, z. B. Giggal (Hahn), Bibbal oda Ziwarl (kloans Hendl), Heiß(al) (jungs Pferd, Foihn), Goaß, Hebbal (junge Goaß), For(n) (Jungstia, Stiakaibe), Böichn (ahd. belihha; Blässhendl), da Imp oda de Impn (Biene), Oachkatzl, Brotz (lat. Loanwoat, Grod), Hotz (Eichlhäha) usw.
english: For animals, there is also a special Bavarian vocabulary, e.g., Giggal (rooster), Bibbal or Ziwarl (small chicken), Heiß(al) (young horse, foal), Goaß (goat), Hebbal (young goat), For(n) (young animal, male deer), Böichn (old Bavarian belihha; speckled chicken), da Imp or de Impn (bee), Oachkatzl (squirrel), Brotz (Latin loanword, Grod), Hotz (squirrel) etc.
note: Misglosses bull, coot and jay, leaves toad untranslated and changes Old High German to Old Bavarian.

bar_text: Zum boarischn Vokabulaa im Bereich vo de Lebmsmiddl schaug: Austro-Boarischa Kuchlwoatschotz.
english: For the Bavarian vocabulary in the area of food, look: Austro-Bavarian kitchen vocabulary.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Des produktivste Suffix zua Buidung vo Adjektiven is -ad; des gehd entweda afs Suffix -ert zruck, oda afs Suffix -end, dees wo eigentli zur Buidung vom Partizip Präsens vawendt wiad (boade Suffixe san im Boarischen lautli zammagfoin).
english: The most productive suffix for the formation of adjectives is -ad; this either goes back to the suffix -ert, or to the suffix -end, which is actually used for the formation of the present participle (both suffixes have merged phonetically in Bavarian).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Stammendunga in Klamman (moast -g oda -ch) wean im traditionejn Boarisch nur gsogt, wens Adjektiv flektiat wead und daduach a vokalische Endung dahoit.
english: Derivations in parentheses (mostly -g or -ch) are only said in traditional Bavarian when the adjective is inflected and thereby maintains a vocalic ending.
note: Stem endings become derivations and acquiring a vowel ending becomes maintaining one.

bar_text: Es gibt owa aa regionale und lokale Ausnohma.
english: But there are also regional and local exceptions.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: 12:15 – Viadl noch zwejfe (sejtana: Viadl iwa zwejfe); weanarisch, nordobaboarisch : Viadl aans
english: 12:15 – Quarter to twelve (dialect: Quarter past twelve); West Franconian, North Upper Bavarian: Quarter one
note: 12:15 becomes quarter to twelve and Viennese becomes West Franconian; rarely also becomes dialect.

bar_text: 12:30 – hoibe/a oans
english: 12:30 – half/one
note: Half/one does not convey the complete half-to-one/half-past-twelve phrase.

bar_text: 12:45 – Dreiviadl oans/Viadl vor oans, sejten: Viadl af oans
english: 12:45 – Three quarters one/Quarter to one, side: Quarter to one
note: sejten means rarely, not side.

bar_text: Bei voin Stundn, ob viar kimmt imma no a -e dazua:
english: With full hours, even four, there is always an -e added:
note: ab viar means starting at four, not even four; the rule's lower bound is lost.

bar_text: 16:00 – viare
english: 16:00 – viare
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: 16:30 – hoibe fimfe
english: 16:30 – half five
note: Half five conventionally means 5:30 in English; the source means half past four.

bar_text: Wia im engl.
english: As in English.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Sprochraum wead in Bayern des 12 h Format vawendd:
english: In Bavaria, the 12 h format will be used in the language area:
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: 14:30 – hoibe drei (am Nammidog)
english: 14:30 – half three (in the afternoon)
note: Half three conventionally means 3:30 in English, not 14:30.

bar_text: De boarischn Wochadogsnama, de wo vom Standarddeitschn etymologisch obweicha (oiso da Deansdog und da Dunnasdog), stamma ausn Einflussbereich vo da Gotischn Sproch.
english: The Bavarian weekdays, which etymologically deviate from Standard German (namely Deansdog and Dunnasdog), stem from the sphere of influence of the Gothic language.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Fir Details schaug: De boarische Wocha
english: For details look: The Bavarian Week
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Es gibt zwoa aa im Standarddeitschn verbale Prefixe, im Boarischn san de owa vui produktiva.
english: There are also two verbal prefixes in standard German, but in Bavarian they are much more productive.
note: Misreads the concessive zwoa ... owa as two verbal prefixes.

bar_text: da- (< der-) entspricht am standarddeitschn er-, kimmt owa a mit Verben voa, de wo im Hochdeitsch des Präfix ned hom kena.
english: da- (corresponds to the standard German er-) also occurs with verbs that did not have the prefix in High German.
note: Omits the older der- form and changes cannot have to did not have.

bar_text: zamm (zamma) [com-] entspricht am Standarddeitschn zusammen-, es wead no haifiga vawendt ois dees.
english: zamm (zamma) [com-] corresponds to the standard German zusammen-, it is being used even more frequently than that.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: S Boarische hod regional vaschiedane Diminutivsuffixe, vo dena -l, -e und -al (< -erl) de haifgstn san.
english: Bavarian has regionally different diminutive suffixes, of which -l, -e and -al (< -erl) are the most common.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Des -l is sogoa stoark lexikalisiat, d. h. s wiad oft gor nimma ois Diminutiv vastandn.
english: This -l is even strongly lexicalized, i.e., it is often no longer understood as a diminutive.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Vui vo de Diminutive ohne a Grundwort beziang se oft af Meschn, deo wo oan af irenoa Oat load doa.
english: Many of the diminutives without a base word often refer to people who act in their own particular way.
note: Acting in their own particular way loses the key evoking-pity meaning.

bar_text: Im Berchtesgoana Land, Cheamgau, Toaln vom Soizburga Land, Soizkammaguad und vom Bayrischn Oberland sowia aa im Tirola Untaland und im steirischn Tauerngebiet is des Diminutivsuffix moast ned -(a)l, sondern -ei.
english: In the Berchtesgaden area, Chiemgau, valleys of the Salzburg area, Salzkammergut and from the Bavarian Upper Land as well as also in the Tyrolean Lowland and in the Styrian Tauern region, the diminutive suffix is mostly not -(a)l, but -ei.
note: Toaln means parts here, not valleys, narrowing the regional distribution.

bar_text: Da Hiasl wiad dann zum Hiasei.
english: Hiasl will then become a "Hiasei" (a person who is finished/done for).
note: Adds an unsupported finished/done-for meaning for the Hiasei name form.

bar_text: Andane Beispui: Dirnei fia Madl, Hansei fia Hansl usw.
english: Other examples: Dirnei for girls, Hansei for Hansl etc.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Deitschland (amtle: Bundesrepublik Deutschland) is a Stoot in Middleiropa.
english: Germany (officially: Federal Republic of Germany) is a state in Central Europe.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Ois Bundesstoot wiad de Bundesrepublik Deutschland aus dena 16 deitschn Ländan buidt.
english: As a federal state, the Federal Republic of Germany is built from the 16 German states.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De Lända gliedan se wieda nochm Vafossungsprinzip vo da kommunaln Sejbstvawoitung in kommunale Gebietskeapaschoftn.
english: The lands are once again divided according to the constitutional principle of municipal self-administration into municipal territorial capacities.
note: Gebietskeapaschoftn are territorial authorities/corporations, not capacities.

bar_text: Bundeshaptstod is Berlin.
english: The federal capital is Berlin.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: As politische System is fedaral und ois parlamentarische Demokratie organisiat.
english: The political system is federal and organized as a parliamentary democracy.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Deitschland is mid eppa 81,8 Mijona Eihwohna (2015) da bevejkarungsreichste Stoot vo da EU.
english: Germany is with about 81.8 million inhabitants (2015) the most populous state of the EU.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Deitschland is unta andam Mitgliad vo de Vaeintn Nationa, vo da NATO und vo de G7 (Gruppm vo de Siem), sowia Grindungsmitgliad vo da EU.
english: Germany is a member of the United Nations, of NATO and of the G7 (Group of Seven), as well as a founding member of the EU.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Des gresste Bundesland vo Deitschland is Bayern, s beväikarungsreichste is Noadrhein-Westfoin.
english: The largest federal state of Germany is Bavaria, the most populous is North Rhine-Westphalia.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Da Begriff Deutschland wead in dera Foam eascht seit da Friajn Neizeit vawendt, zum Beispui in Die Verfassung des deutschen Reiches (1667) vom Samuel von Pufendorf.
english: The term Germany is first used in this form since the Early Modern period, for example in The Constitution of the German Empire (1667) by Samuel von Pufendorf.
note: The historical word under discussion is Deutschland, not the English word Germany.

bar_text: Voahea hods deitsch nua ois Eigschoftswoat gebm, in da Foam vo: a deitsches Land oda de deitschn Lända owa ned zammagsetz; ned amoi ois das deitsche Land.
english: Previously, German was only given as an adjective, in the form of: a German country or the German countries, but not composed; not even as the German country.
note: Loses the actual German forms whose historical adjectival/compound use is the point.

bar_text: Deitschland liegt in Middleiropa, zwischn 47°16′15″ und 55°03′33″ neadlicha Broadn und 5°52′01″ und 15°02′37″ estlicha Leng.
english: Germany lies in Central Europe, between 47°16′15″ and 55°03′33″ northern latitude and 5°52′01″ and 15°02′37″ eastern longitude.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Im Noadn grenzt Deitschland an Dänemark (auf ana Läng vo 67 km), im Nordostn an Poin (442 km), im Ostn an d Tschechei (811 km), im Südosten an Östareich (815 km; ohne Grenz im Bodnsee), im Sidn an d Schweiz (316 km; mid Grenzn vo da Exklave Büsingen, owa ohne Grenz im Bodnsee), im Siidwestn an Frankreich (448 km), im Westn an Luxmburg (135 km) und Belgien (156 km) und im Nordwestn an Holland (567 km).
english: In the north, Germany borders Denmark (along a length of 67 km), in the northeast Poland (442 km), in the east the Czech Republic (811 km), in the southeast Austria (815 km; without a border in Lake Constance), in the south Switzerland (316 km; with borders from the enclave Büsingen, but without a border in Lake Constance), in the southwest France (448 km), in the west Luxembourg (135 km) and Belgium (156 km) and in the northwest Holland (567 km).
note: Uses enclave where the source specifies Germany's exclave Busingen.

bar_text: De Grenzläng betrogt insgesamt 3757 km.
english: The border length amounts to a total of 3757 km.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Wearend im Nordwestn de Kistn vo da Nordsee und im Nordostn de vo da Ostsee de natialichn Stootsgrenzn buidn, hod Deitschland im Sidn Ontei on de Oipn.
english: We form the natural state borders with the boxes of the North Sea in the northwest and those of the Baltic Sea in the northeast, and Germany has the Alps in the southern part.
note: While becomes we and coastlines become boxes, corrupting the natural-boundary claim.

bar_text: Deitschland gheat voiständig zua gmäßigtn Klimazone vo Middleiropa im Bereich vo da Westwindzone.
english: Germany belongs entirely to the temperate climate zone of Central Europe in the area of the westerlies.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: S liegt im Iwagangsbereich zwischn am Seeklima in Westeiropa und am Kontinentalklima in Osteiropa.
english: It lies in the transition zone between a maritime climate in Western Europe and a continental climate in Eastern Europe.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: S Klima wead zuadem vom Goifstrom stoak beeinflusst, dea wo de klimatischn Weate fia de Broadnlog ungwehnli muid gstoitn duat.
english: The climate is being increasingly strongly influenced by the Golf Stream, which causes the climatic weather for the Broadnlog to be unusually mild.
note: Adds increasingly and leaves the latitude reference Broadnlog untranslated.

bar_text: De middlare jearliche Niedaschlogsmenge is 700 Millimeter (begzong auf de Joar vo 1961 -1990).
english: The average annual precipitation amount is 700 millimeters (referring to the years 1961 - 1990).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De middlare Niadaschlogsmenge pro Monat liegt zwischn 40 Millimeta im Feba und 77 Millimeta im Juni.
english: The average precipitation amount per month lies between 40 millimeters in February and 77 millimeters in June.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De tiafste jo in Deitschland gmessane Temparatua woa −45,9 Grad Celsius; se is am 24. Dezemba 2001 am Funtensee gmessn woan.
english: The lowest temperature measured in Germany was −45.9 degrees Celsius; it was measured on December 24, 2001, at Funtensee.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De bislang hechste Temparatur woa 40,3 Grad Celsius und is am 8. August 2003 in Nennig im Saarland erfosst woan.
english: The highest temperature so far was 40.3 degrees Celsius and was recorded on August 8, 2003, in Nennig in Saarland.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De Ogobm dazua san owa zum Tei wiedasprichli.
english: The bosses for that are, however, partly contradictory.
note: Ogobm means reports/data, not bosses.

bar_text: Dees kristalline Gstoa in Deitschland, wia Gneis und Granit in de Middlgebiag, geht afs Paleozoikum (Eadoitadum) zruck.
english: The crystalline rocks in Germany, such as gneiss and granite in the central uplands, date back to the Paleozoic (Eoarchean).
note: Eadoitadum refers to the Paleozoic, not the Eoarchean era added in parentheses.

bar_text: Deitschland liegt voi af da Eirasischn Plottn, trotzdem keman schwoche Eadbebm fia.
english: Germany lies completely on the Eurasian plate, nevertheless weak earthquakes come.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Bsundas guit dees fia Sidwestn (Region vo de Riftzona) und im Westn (Obarheingrobm, Rheingrobm, Hohenzollangrobm).
english: Especially good is this for the southwest (region of the rift zone) and in the west (Upper Rhine Graben, Rhine Graben, Hohenzollern Graben).
note: Especially good changes applies especially into an evaluative claim.

bar_text: In da Nordsee dominian de Inselgruppm vo de Nordfriesischn Insln und de Inslkettn vo de Ostfriesischn Insln.
english: In the North Sea, the island groups of the North Frisian Islands and the island chain of the East Frisian Islands are located.
note: Located omits that these island groups predominate.

bar_text: Helgoland und Neuwerk san aa bewont.
english: Helgoland and Neuwerk are also inhabited.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De Nordfriesischn Insln san Restln vom Festland, wo duach Landsenkung und nochfoigende Iwaflutung vo da Kistn trennt worn san.
english: The North Frisian islands are remnants of the mainland, which were separated by land subsidence and subsequent flooding from the mainland.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De Ostfriesischn Insln san Barriereinsln, wo duach de Brandungsdynamik aus Sandbenkn enstondn san.
english: The East Frisian Islands are barrier islands that were created from sandbanks through surf dynamics.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De Flora is in Deitschland vo da gmäßigtn Klimazone vun Lab- und Nodlwejida pregt.
english: The flora in Germany is characterized by the temperate climate zone of lab and needle forests.
note: Lab means deciduous/broadleaf, not lab.

bar_text: De Labwejda bestenga moastns aus Rotbuachn, danem gibts Oachnwejda und imma sejtna aa Auwejda.
english: The riparian forest consists mostly of beech, besides that there are oak forests and even more rarely also willow forests.
note: Deciduous forests become riparian forests and floodplain forests become willow forests.

bar_text: In de Oipn und Middlgebiag gibts Schluchtwoid.
english: In the Alps and mountain regions, there is forest path.
note: Ravine forest becomes a forest path.

bar_text: Ohne menschlichn Eifluss dadat de Vegetation in Deitschland haaptsächli aus Woid besteh.
english: Without human influence, the vegetation in Germany would mainly consist of forest.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Deazeit san 29,5 Prozent vo da Stootsflöchn Woid.
english: At present, 29.5 percent of the state area is forest.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Damit gheat Deitschland zu dena woidreichstn Lända vo da Eiropejischen Union(EU).
english: Thus Germany belongs to those most extensive countries of the European Union (EU).
note: Most extensive countries loses the source's forest-rich/most-forested criterion.

bar_text: Weidas gibts no Hoad- und Moorlandschoftn sowia vegetationsoame oipine Regiona.
english: Furthermore, there are still hair- and moor landscapes as well as vegetationally open regions.
note: Heath becomes hair and Alpine is omitted.

bar_text: Da gresste Otei vom unbebautn Land wead fian Obau vo Nutzpflanzn vawendd; voa oim Droad wia Geastn, Hafa, Roggn und Woazn; dozua kema voa oim no Erdepfi un Raps.
english: The largest part of the unbuilt land will be used for the cultivation of crops; above all grain such as spelt, barley, rye and wheat; in addition to that, first of all, potatoes and rapeseed.
note: Geastn/Hafa are barley/oats, not spelt/barley.

bar_text: In mangn Flussdoin wia an da Mosl, am Main und am Rhein zum Beispui wead Wein obaut.
english: In many river valleys, such as the Moselle, the Main, and the Rhine for example, wine is grown.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De moastn Saigeviecha in Deitschland lebm in de Labwejda.
english: The most disgusting animals in Germany live in the laboratories.
note: Mammals in deciduous forests become disgusting animals in laboratories.

bar_text: Do gibts vaschiedane Marderoatn, Dam- und Rothiaschn, Reh, Wuidsaun und Fuxn.
english: There are various types of martens, dam and red squirrels, roe deer, wild boar and foxes.
note: The two deer species become dam and red squirrels.

bar_text: Biba und Otta findt ma in Flussauen nua no sejtn, zum Tei gibts owa aa wieda steigende Beständ.
english: Biba and Otta are only found rarely in the river meadows now, though on the part there are also rising numbers again.
note: Leaves the key species Biba and Otta untranslated rather than identifying beavers and otters.

bar_text: Andane gräßare Saigeviecha de wo friaha in Middleiropa glebt hom gibts nimma.
english: Other larger vile creatures that used to live in Central Europe no longer exist.
note: Mammals become vile creatures, adding an evaluative claim and losing the biological class.

bar_text: An Auaoxn (seit 1846), an Braunbär (seit 1835), an Ejch (seitm Middloida), s Wuidpferd (seitm 19. Joahundat), an Wisent (seitm 17./18.
english: An ox (since 1846), a brown bear (since 1835), an elk (since the Middle Ages), the wild horse (since the 19th century), a wisent (since the 17./18.
note: Auaoxn means aurochs, not a generic ox.

bar_text: Joahhundat und an Woif (seit 1904).
english: A hundred and a half (since 1904).
note: Loses century and wolf, retaining only the date in a nonsensical hundred-and-a-half phrase.

bar_text: In neiara Zeit wandan gelegentli Ejche, Wejfe und mangmoi sogoa Bärn ein.
english: In modern times, eggs, women, and sometimes even bears occasionally come in.
note: Elk and wolves become eggs and women; only returning bears is preserved.

bar_text: Wengam schlechtn Ruaf vom Woif und vom Bärn fiaht dees owa efta za Problem.
english: Because of the bad reputation of the wolf and the bear, this often leads to problems.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Deitschland besteht aus 16 teisouvarena Lenda.
english: Germany consists of 16 sovereign countries.
note: teisouverän means partly sovereign, not sovereign countries.

bar_text: De ejtastn Siadlungsbelege afn Gebiet vom heitign Deitschland san etwa 700.000 Joar oid und ma gehd davo aus, dass de Region seit 500.000 Joar permanent bsiadlt is.
english: The oldest settlement evidence in the area of present-day Germany is about 700,000 years old and it is assumed that the region has been permanently inhabited for 500,000 years.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Es gibt dahea in Deitschland aa bedeitende paläoanthropologische Fundstättn: Nöchm Fundort bei Heidelberg is de Hominini-Oat Homo heidelbergensis gnennt woan und nochm Neandertal in Mettmann da Homo neanderthalensis, dea wo ausm Homo heidelbergensis heavoagangane Neandertaler.
english: There are also significant paleoanthropological sites there in Germany: after the discovery site near Heidelberg, the Hominini species was called Homo heidelbergensis, and after the Neander Valley in Mettmann, Homo neanderthalensis, the Neanderthal who descended from Homo heidelbergensis.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De Menschnoat is voa etwa 40.000 Joar dann vom Homo sapiens(moderna Mensch), dea wo aus Afrika kema is, vadrängt woan.
english: The Neanderthal was displaced about 40,000 years ago by the Homo sapiens (modern human), who came from Africa.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: In da Jungstoazeit hom se nacha Ackabau, Viechazucht und feste Siedlungsplätz entwicket.

bar_text: Se enwtickit de Konzepte zua Vaständnis und zua Löösung vo de Probleme zwischn da Wöd und' Menschn.
english: It develops the concepts for the understanding and for the solution of the problems between the world and humans.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Gegnstond vo da Geografie is de gsommte Geosfäre.
english: The subject of geography is the entire geosphere.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Vorlage:Infobox Fluss/NACHWEISE_ausVorlage:Infobox Fluss/Veraltet
english: Template:Infobox River/EVIDENCE_fromTemplate:Infobox River/Obsolete
note: The source is a residual infobox/template identifier rather than an interpretable prose translation unit.

bar_text: De Isar is a Fluss, der wo vo de Oipn durch Minga fliaßt und letzendlich gengiba vo Degndorf in d Donau münden duat.
english: The Isar is a river that flows from the Alps through Munich and ultimately flows into the Danube opposite Deggendorf.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Da Ursprung liagt in Estareich im Hinteraudoi vom Kawendl-Gebirg.
english: The origin lies in Austria in the Hinterautal of the Karwendel mountains.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Zwischn Scharnitz und Mittnwoid fliaßts iaba d' Grenz vo Estareich noch Bayern (Deitschland).
english: Between Scharnitz and Mittenwald, it flows across the border from Austria to Bavaria (Germany).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Se hod a Leng vo 295 Kilometa.
english: It has a length of 295 kilometers.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Neba Minga liang de Städt Däiz, Freising, Moosburg und Landshuad an da Isar.
english: Besides Munich, the cities of Dachau, Freising, Moosburg and Landshut lie on the Isar.
note: Däiz refers to Bad Tölz, not Dachau.

bar_text: De greaßtn Zufliass han d' Amper bei Moosburg, d' Loisach bei Wolfratshausn und d' Moosach bei Freising.
english: The largest tributaries are the Amper near Moosburg, the Loisach near Wolfratshausen, and the Moosach near Freising.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: D' Isar is noch da Donau, am Inn und am Main da viertlängste Fluss in Bayern.
english: After the Danube, the Inn and the Main, the Isar is the fourth longest river in Bavaria.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Lange Zeit hods ghoaßn, der Nama Isar dad ausm keltischn kemma und sovui wia reißnds Wossa (ys = schnej, reißnd und ura = Wossa, Fluss) bedeitn.
english: For a long time it was said that the name Isar came from Celtic and meant something like rushing water (ys = snow, rushing and ura = water, river).
note: schnej means fast here, not snow; the rest of the historical Celtic explanation is retained.

bar_text: Des guid inzwischn ois vaaltate Meinung.
english: That is now considered an outdated opinion.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: D'Sprachforscher moana jetzad es dad vo da indogermanischn Wurzl es/is (fia fließnds Wossa) kemma, de se a in fui andane Flußnama wiadafindt und se in aktuelle Sprachn nua no aufs feste Wossa, oiso s Eis bziagt.
english: Language researchers now think that it would have come from the Indo-European root es/is (for flowing water), which is also found in many other river names and, in current languages, only refers to solid water, i.e., ice.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: A guads Drum vom Wossa des auf'd boarischn Oipn unds Kawendl foid fliaßt durch d' Isar zur Donau und so bis ins Schwoazze Meea.
english: A good amount of water that falls on the Bavarian Alps and the Karwendel flows through the Isar to the Danube and so on into the Black Sea.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: S' gsamte Einzugsgebiat hod a Flächn vo 9000 Quadratkilometa.
english: The entire catchment area has an area of 9000 square kilometers.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Wei a Guads vom Niedaschlog in de Berg ois Schnee foid hods zur Schneeschmelz as meiste Wossa.
english: Because a good amount of precipitation falls in the mountains as snow, it provides most of the water during the snowmelt.
note: It provides most of the water is less precise than the river having its greatest water volume during snowmelt.

bar_text: Mit am mittlern Abfluss vo 175 Kubikmeta in da Sekund zählt d' Isar zu de mittlgroßn deitschn Flüss.
english: With an average discharge of 175 cubic meters per second, the Isar is among the medium-sized German rivers.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Ma kos sogseng mit am Lech, da Mosel, am Main und am Neckar vagleicha.
english: It can be compared with the Lech, the Moselle, the Main, and the Neckar.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Da Ursprung vo da Isar liagt im Hinteraudoi im Karwendl auf 1.160 Meta iaba Normalnui ( Koordinaten fehlen! Hilf mit. ...).
english: The origin of the Isar lies in the Hinterautal in the Karwendel at 1,160 meters above sea level (coordinates are missing! Help out. ...).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Do fliaßt da Lafatsch an de Isarquelln vorbei.
english: There the Lafatsch flows past the Isar springs.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Da Lafatsch hod sei Quelln in da Nach vom Hallerangerhaus.
english: The Lafatsch has its source in the vicinity of the Halleranger house.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Er is da längste vo de Quellbäch.
english: It is the longest of the spring brooks.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Sei Nama ändert se bei de Isarquelln in Isar, oafach wei de Quelln vui mehra Wassa bringa, ois ea sejba hod.
english: Its name changes to Isar at the Isar springs, simply because the springs bring much more water than it itself has.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: In de Berg han ois wichtige Nebnflüß da Rißbach, d' Achn und d'Jachn zum dawähna.
english: In the mountains, the Rißbach, the Achn, and the Jachn are to be mentioned as important tributaries.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Da Rißbach kimmt aus da Eng und trifft bei Vorderriß auf d' Isar.
english: The Rißbach comes from the Eng and meets the Isar at Vorderriß.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: D'Achn kimmt vom Achensee und mündt in Sylvensteinsee, dem sei Zua- und Abfluß d' Isar is.
english: The Ache comes from the Achensee and flows into Sylvensteinsee, whose inflow and outflow is the Isar.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: D'Jachn kimmt vom Walchasee, fliaßt durch d' Jachenau und mündt in da Nach vo Fleck und Wegscheid.
english: The Jachn comes from the Walchsee, flows through the Jachenau and flows into the Isar near Fleck and Wegscheid.
note: Walchsee is a different lake; context identifies the source's Walchasee as Walchensee.

bar_text: De wichtigstn Nebenflüß außahoib vo de Berg han d' Amper und d' Loisach.
english: The most important tributaries outside of the mountains are the Amper and the Loisach.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De meistn Inseln und Kiesbänk in da Isar untaliegn wega de starkn Hochwassa a ständign Änderung in ihra Form und Log.
english: Most of the islands and gravel banks in the Isar are constantly changing in their shape and location due to the strong floods.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: D'Isar werd auf vaschiedne Artn zur Energie-Gewinnung gnutzt.
english: The Isar is used in various ways for energy production.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: A guada Tei vom Isarwossa werd in da Nach vo Mittnwoid zum Woichnsää umgleit.
english: A good part of the Isar water is diverted to the Walchensee near Mittenwald during the night of Wednesday.
note: in da Nach means nearby; Wednesday night is invented.

bar_text: Des werd gmacht, wei s' Woichnsääkraftwerk mehra Wossa bracht, ois vo sejba in See fliaßt.
english: This is done because the Walchensee power plant brings in more water than flows into the lake by itself.
note: bracht here means needs; brings in reverses the plant's role in the water-need explanation.

bar_text: Da Sylvenstoa is a Stausee, dear vor oim gegas Hochwassa baut worn is, aba a zua Stromerzeugung gnutzt werd.
english: The Sylvenstein is a reservoir that was built primarily to protect against high water, but is also used for electricity generation.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Im weidan Valauf gibts mehrane Flußkraftwerke z. B. am neadlichn Stadtrand vo Däiz und de Isarwerke 1-3 inahoib vo Minga.
english: In the further course, there are several hydroelectric power plants, e.g., on the northern outskirts of Deggendorf and the Isar plants 1-3 near Munich.
note: Däiz is Bad Tolz, not Deggendorf; the Munich plants are within, not merely near, Munich.

bar_text: Neba da Nutzung vo da Wassakraft is as Isarwassa indirekt ois Kühlwassa fias Kernkraftwerk Isar bei Landshut vo Bedeitung.
english: Besides the use of hydropower, the Isar water is indirectly of importance as cooling water for the Isar nuclear power plant near Landshut.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: A wenn Wassakraft ois was recht umweltfreindlichs ogseng werd hods fia'd Isar einschneidnde Folgn.
english: Even if hydropower is being presented as something quite environmentally friendly, it has far-reaching consequences for the Isar.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Lange Zeit is as ganze Wassa zum Woichasee umgleit worn.
english: For a long time, all the water has been diverted to Lake Walchensee.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Da a as meiste vom Rißboch zum Woichasee umgleit wurd is d'Isar zwischn Krea und am Sylvenstoa ab und zua a austrocknd.
english: Since most of the Rißbach was diverted to the Walchensee, the Isar between Kreuth and the Sylvenstein is occasionally drying up.
note: Krea here is Krun, not Kreuth; the drying is also shifted to the present.

bar_text: Des ganze Wassa kimmt zwar letzendlich iaban Kochesee und Loisach wiada zruck in d'Isar, aba bis Wolfratshausn fejds im Flußlauf.
english: All the water does eventually come back into the Isar via the Kochelsee and Loisach, but it is missing from the river course up to Wolfratshausen.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Inzwischn werd a greaßana Teil vom Wossa in da Isar glassn.
english: In the meantime, a larger part of the water is being left in the Isar.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: A de fuin Seitnkanäle fia de Flußkraftwerk z. B. in da Nach vo Minga entziehn am wildn Flußlauf as Wossa.
english: Even the side channels for the hydroelectric power plants, e.g., in the vicinity of Munich, withdraw water from the wild river course.
note: Omits that the side channels are numerous.

bar_text: Außadem vahindern de Wehre an Transport vom Geschiebe.
english: In addition, the weirs prevent the transport of the sediment.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Deszweng grobt se d' Isar a tiafas Flußbett.
english: Because of this, the Isar digs itself a deep riverbed.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: A de Nutzung ois Kühlwassa fias Kernkraftwerk tuat am Fluß ned guad, wei dadurch sei Temperatur steigt.
english: Using it as cooling water for the nuclear power plant is not good for the river, because its temperature rises as a result.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Dafia gibts aba Grenzwert, in oam hoaßn Somma hod as Kernkraftwerk scho drosselt wern miaßn, weis sonst de Umweltauflagn ned dafüllt hed.
english: However, there are limits to that; in one hot summer, the nuclear power plant already had to be throttled, otherwise it would not have met the environmental requirements.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Fast scho zum Nama dazua gheard ois Zuasotz da Farbeidruck.
english: The color impression almost belongs to the name as an addition.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: S' is ois greane Isar bekannt.
english: It is known as the green Isar.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Des is aba nua de Farb vo am klarn Wossa, des erscheint tatsächli greablau.
english: But that is only the color of clear water, which actually appears gray-blue.
note: greablau means green-blue, not gray-blue.

bar_text: De Farb hods in niederschlogsarme Zeitn, wenn da greaßte Teil vom Wossa aus de Quelln stammt.
english: The color is present in low-precipitation periods, when the greatest part of the water comes from the springs.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Noch starke Regnfäll gibts durch Erosion an Haffa Schlamm und Dreck im Wossa, dann werds undurchsichtig lehmig braun.
english: After heavy rainfall, there is a lot of mud and dirt in the water due to erosion, then it becomes opaque, loamy brown.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Iaba s' Enstehen vo dea greablaun Farb is ma se ned ganz einig.
english: However, I am not entirely sure about the emergence of this greenish-blue color.
note: ma se means people/there is agreement here, not the speaker's personal uncertainty.

bar_text: Wahrscheinlich is a Zammspui vo Algn und am glästn Koich.
english: It is probably a combination of algae and light-colored pebbles.
note: glästn Koich means dissolved lime, not light-colored pebbles.

bar_text: Da Eindruck werd vastärkt durch de helln Koichsteana am Grund vom Fluß und dem sonst recht klarn Wossa.
english: The impression is reinforced by the bright pebbles at the bottom of the river and the otherwise quite clear water.
note: Bright pebbles omit the limestone material.

bar_text: Dadurch kimmt a Haffa Liacht aus'm Fluß zruck und iabastrahlt des vo da Oberflächn reflektierte Liacht.
english: As a result, a lot of light comes back from the river and irradiates the light reflected from the surface.
note: Changes outshines to irradiates, losing the comparison between the two light sources.

bar_text: So hod de tatsächliche Farb vom Wassa an greaßan Eifluß auf an Farbeidruck ois de Farb vom Himme oda da Umgebung.
english: Thus, the actual color of the water has a greater influence on the color impression than the color of the sky or the surroundings.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Fo da Farb is a as Biamischdrangl d'Isarmass inspiriad.
english: Because of the color, the Isar massif has also inspired the Bavarian mixture.
note: Turns the Isarmass drink into an Isar massif and reverses the inspiration relationship.

bar_text: Zwischn Arzbach und Däiz is oana recht fleißig dabei, daß a noch am jedn Hochwassa seine Stoahaffa nei aufschicht.
english: Between Arzbach and Deiz, someone is quite busy making sure that he piles up his stone heaps again at every flood.
note: At every flood is less precise than the explicit after every flood.

bar_text: De Haffa han ois Isarpyramidn bekannt und a scho mehrmois in da Zeidung und am Fernsehn erwähnt worn.
english: The piles are known as Isar pyramids and have already been mentioned several times in the newspaper and on television.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Da Erbauer sejba nend des Platzl Kloa-Kairo.
english: The builder himself doesn't call the little place 'Clear Cairo'.
note: Negates the source's calls and changes Little Cairo to Clear Cairo.

bar_text: A Altarbuidl vo 1480 in da Jakobskirch in Lengrias is a Beispui fia oide Darstellunga vo da Isar.
english: An altar picture from 1480 in St. James' Church in Lengries is an example of old depictions of the Isar.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Da unbkannte Moier hod s'Köpfn vom Apostel Jakobus ans Ufer vo da Isar valegt.
english: The unknown monk laid the head of the Apostle James on the bank of the Isar.
note: Painter becomes monk, and relocating the beheading scene becomes laying down a head.

bar_text: Im 19. Jahrhundert ham an Haffa Mola aus da Münchner Schui d' Isar ois Motiv fia eanane Buidl entdeckt.
english: In the 19th century, a lot of painters from the Munich School discovered the Isar as a motif for their pictures.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Wei de recht gnau gmoid hom wern de Buidl a ois Dokumentation fia de Vaänderunga vo da Landschaft durch d'Leid ogseng.
english: Because they were painted quite precisely, these pictures are also seen by people as documentation of the changes to the landscape.
note: durch d'Leid modifies the landscape changes caused by people, not who regards the pictures as documentation.

bar_text: Im Jäger vo Foi hod da Ludwig Ganghofer am Isarwinke und seine Bewohna a literarischs Denkmoi gsetzt und damit zur Bekanntheit vo der Gengd beitrong.
english: In 'The Hunter of Fall,' Ludwig Ganghofer created a literary monument to the Isarwinkel and its inhabitants, thereby contributing to the fame of the region.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Oans vo am Willy Michl seine erfolgreichstn Liadl is as Isarflimmern.
english: One of Willy Michl's most successful songs is Isarflimmern.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Er sejba hod an so starkn Bzug zum Fluß, daß a se Isarindianer nend.
english: He himself has such a strong attraction to the river that he calls himself an Isar Indian.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Bejgien (Holländisch: België, Franzesisch: Belgique, Deitsch: Belgien), offiziäi Kinigreich Bejgien (holl.: Koninkrijk België, franz.: Royaume de Belgique) is a fedaral organisirschte parlamentarische Monarchie in Westeiropa, houd uma 10,5 Millionan Einwohna und is 30.528 km² gross und is a Mitglied vo da Eiropäischn Union.
english: Belgium (Dutch: België, French: Belgique, German: Belgien), officially Kingdom of Belgium (Dutch: Koninkrijk België, French: Royaume de Belgique) is a federally organized parliamentary monarchy in Western Europe, has around 10.5 million inhabitants, is 30,528 km² in size, and is a member of the European Union.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Es grenzt an Holland, Deitschland, Luxnbuag, Frankreich und an de Nordsee.
english: It borders Holland, Germany, Luxembourg, France and the North Sea.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Mid Holland und Luxnbuag zomm bijdt Bejgien de Beneluxstootn.
english: Together with Holland and Luxembourg, Belgium forms the Benelux states.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Seid da Unobhängigkeit vo 1830 und da Vafossungsgewung vo 1831 is Bejgien a parlamentarische Monarchie.
english: Since the independence of 1830 and the granting of the constitution in 1831, Belgium has been a parliamentary monarchy.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: De flämische Beväikarung im Noadn, da franzesische Sidn mid na Minderheit in da Haptstod Brissl und a kloane deitschsprouchige Beväikarung an Ostn bijdn an ohoitaschtn Konflikthead, dem wous seid de 1970er Jou durch a Denzentroiisirung vo da Stoutsorganisazion und 1993 durch de Umwondlung in an Bundesstout zan begegnan vasuacht woun is.
english: The Flemish population in the north, the French in the south with a minority in the capital Brussels, and a small German-speaking population in the east form an old conflict issue, which has been attempted to be countered since the 1970s through a decentralization of the state organization and in 1993 through the transformation into a federal state.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Denneascht homd owa de gengsätzlichn Intressn vo de Vatreta vo de boadn grossn Beväikarungsgruppm (Sprouchgruppm gnonnt) weiderhi de bäigische Politik prägt und beeiflusst.
english: However, the opposing interests of the representatives of the large population groups (referred to as language groups) have continued to shape and influence Belgian politics.
note: Omits that there are two large population/language groups.

bar_text: Da Bundesstout Bejgien is in droi Gmoaschouftn (de flämische, franzesische und de deitsche Gmoaschouft) sowia in droi Regionan (Flandern, Wallonien und de Region Brissl-Hauptstod) eitoaet.
english: The federal state Belgium is divided into three communities (the Flemish, French, and German communities) as well as into three regions (Flanders, Wallonia, and the Brussels-Capital Region).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Bejgien is a Grindungsmidgliad vo da Eiropäischn Wiatschoftsgmoaschoft (EWG), da heiting Eiropäischn Union (EU), vo dera de wichtigstn Instituziona in da Hauptstoud Brissl eanan Sitz homd.
english: Belgium is a founding member of the European Economic Community (EEC), the current European Union (EU), of which the most important institutions have their seat in the capital Brussels.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Ougsechn vom Berglaund vo de Ardennen im Siidostn is Bejgien a weidgeheaschts ewernes Laund.
english: Apart from the mountain range of the Ardennes in the southeast, Belgium is a somewhat eternal land.
note: ewernes means flat, not eternal; the central geographic characterization is lost.

bar_text: De Wossakantn dastreckt se auf 72,3 km.
english: The water divide extends over 72.3 km.
note: Coastline becomes a water divide.

bar_text: 25 Prozent vo da Laundesflächn wernd fia de Laundwirtschouft gnitzt.
english: 25 percent of the land area are used for agriculture.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Uma 95 Prozent vo oie Bäigier leem in Städt.
english: Around 95 percent of all Belgians live in cities.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Laut de Berechnungan vom Kiniglichn Bäigischn Institut fia Naturwissnschouftn houd Bejgien a Flächn vo 30.528 km².
english: According to the calculations of the Royal Belgian Institute for Natural Sciences, Belgium has an area of 30,528 km².
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Im Vijväikerstout Bejgien leem holländisch reedeaschte Flamen (59% vo da Beväikarung), franzesischsprochige Wallonen (40%) und a deitschsprouchige Minderheit (Ripuarische Reinfrankn mid za. 1%) zomm.
english: In the Belgian federal state, Dutch-speaking Flemish (59% of the population), French-speaking Walloons (40%), and a German-speaking minority (Ripuarian Ripuarian Franks with approx. 1%) live together.
note: Multiethnic state becomes federal state and the Rhine Franconian classification is imprecisely rendered.

bar_text: De weiderne Wonbeväikarung bestet aus Zuagwondeaschte aus vij Toaen vo Eiropa (bsundeascht aus Poin, Italien und Marokko).
english: The further resident population consists of immigrants from five continents (especially from Asia, Italy and Morocco).
note: Many parts of Europe becomes five continents and Poland becomes Asia.

bar_text: In Bejgien gibbs heid droi Omtssprouchn: Holländisch (Flämisch san de holländischn Dialekt in Flandern), Franzesisch und Deitsch (san de westmittldeitschn Dialekt und de hochdeitsche Omtssprouch in Ostbejgien).
english: In Belgium there are three official languages today: Dutch (Flemish are the Dutch dialects in Flanders), French and German (are the West Central German dialects and the High German official language in East Belgium).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Seid da Unouhänigkeit vo Bejgien 1830 houd alloa Franzesisch ois Omtssprouch vom Stout goitn.
english: Since the independence of Belgium in 1830, French alone has been the official language of the state.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Im Jou 1873 is Holländisch ois zwoate offiziäie Omtssprouch im bäigischn Kinigreich rechtlich oerkonnt woun, owa trotzdem is d' Vawoitungs- und Untarichtssprouch in gonz Bejgien alloa Franzesisch gween.
english: In the year 1873, Dutch was legally recognized as the second official language in the Belgian Kingdom, but nevertheless, the administrative and educational language in all of Belgium was only French.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: 1919, oiso nouchm Erschtn Wäidkriag, is Deitsch ois Omtssprouch fir d' Leid im neich dazuagwungernen Gebiat an Ostn dazua kemma.
english: In 1919, so after the First World War, German was added as an official language for the people in the newly annexed territory in the east.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Erscht danouch houd d' grosse Merheit vo de Flamen mid Nouchdruck gfordeascht, dass eaner holländische Muattersprouch a ois Vawoitungs- und Unterrichtssprouch an Schuin und Universitätn vawendt und da franzesischn Omtssprouch gleichstäid weascht.
english: Only afterwards did the great majority of the Flemings demand with pressure that their Dutch mother tongue also be used as an administrative and instructional language at schools and universities and that it be made equal to the French official language.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: 1921 houd de bäigische Regirung de territoriale Oasprouchigkeit vo eanare Bewoner in de droi regionoin Sprouchgebiatn oerkonnt: de holländische Sprouchzone Flandern, de franzesische Sprouchzone Wallonie und de doudro grenzeaschte deitsche Sprouchzone in Ostbejgien.
english: In 1921, the Belgian government recognized the territoriality of the language of its inhabitants in the three regional language areas: the Dutch language area Flanders, the French language area Wallonia, and the German language area in East Belgium, which borders there.
note: The wording loses the explicit monolingual character of each territory.

bar_text: Des letzterne Gebiat houd zavur zan Deitschn Reich ghärscht und is nouch'm Erschtn Wäidkriag und duachn Versailler Vatroug an Bejgien ogschlossn woun.
english: This last territory previously belonged to the German Reich and was annexed to Belgium after the First World War and through the Treaty of Versailles.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: An Status vo Regionoisprouchn houmd seid 1990 Lothringisch, Champenois, Fränkisch, Picardisch und Wallonisch.
english: Since 1990, the status of regional languages has been Lotharingian, Champenois, Franconian, Picard, and Walloon.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Ebber 75 Prozent vo de bäigischn Stoutsbiaga sand remisch-katholisch, runde 1 Prozent ghärnd ner protestantischn Kirch o, und 4 Prozent islamische Gmoana.
english: About 75 percent of the Belgian inhabitants are Roman Catholic, around 1 percent belong to the Protestant church, and 4 percent to Islamic communities.
note: Stoutsbiaga means citizens, not all inhabitants.

bar_text: Da Otoae vo konfesionslose betroug uma 20 Prozent.
english: The proportion of non-religious people is around 20 percent.
note: Unaffiliated becomes non-religious, and the past statistic is presented as current.

bar_text: De federale bäigische Regiarung untastitzt und oerkennt seggs Religionan und a nid-konfesionäie Wäidoschaung o: de Anglikanische Kiach, en Islam, as Judndum, de Remisch-Katholische Kirch, de Orthodoxe Kiach, a uniate protestantische Kiach und de Freigeistige Wäidoschaungsgmoaschouft.
english: The federal Belgian government supports and recognizes six religions and a non-confessional worldview: the Anglican Church, Islam, Judaism, the Roman Catholic Church, the Orthodox Church, a uniate Protestant Church and the freethinking worldview community.
note: uniate is an imprecise rendering of the united Protestant church.

bar_text: Berlin is de Bundeshaptstod und da Regiarungssitz vo Deitschland.
english: Berlin is the federal capital and the seat of government of Germany.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Aussadem is s a oagnas Bundesland und as Zentrum vo da Metropolregion Berlin-Brandenburg.
english: Besides, it is its own federal state and the center of the Berlin-Brandenburg metropolitan region.
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: Berlin is mit uma 3,6 Milliona Einwohna de gresste Stod vo Deitschland (noch da Bevejkarung und noch da Flächn).
english: Berlin is the largest city in Germany with around 3.6 million inhabitants (according to population and according to area).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.

bar_text: In da EU is de gresste Stod noch da Bevejkarung und de fiatgresste noch da Flächn.
english: In the EU, it is the largest city after population and the largest after area.
note: Changes fourth largest by area to largest by area.

bar_text: Berlin wor in seine Gschicht scho mehrfoch a Haptstod, wia beispuisweis vom Kurfiaschtndum Brandenburg, vum Kinireich Breissn, vum Deitschn Reich und vo da DDR (nua im Osttei vo da Stod).
english: Berlin was already a capital several times in its history, for example of the Electorate of Brandenburg, of the Kingdom of Prussia, of the German Reich and of the GDR (only in the eastern part of the city).
note: All substantive source claims preserved.
